svg.text: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 · GC9A01 1.28" round display with CST816 touch · MPU6050 · 3.7 V LiPo · vibration motor
pin order on your module may differ:
⚠ check polarity with a multimeter before connecting
B = base · C = collector · E = emitter
crossing without a dot = NOT connected
display SCL/SDA are SPI, not I²C
Tip: on a breadboard, run XIAO 3V3 to the red (+) rail and GND to the blue (−) rail, then plug every 3V3 / GND connection into those rails.
Pin map matches firmware/include/pins.h and docs/wiring.md in the esp32-smartwatch repo.
